situations.title: 지혈대 압력 설정
situations.tagline: What pressure are we setting the tourniquet to for this limb?
situations.brief: 사지 혈압을 기준으로 지혈대 압력을 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm setting the cuff pressure based on the limb occlusion pressure.
For an arm, we typically use a lower setting.
Let me confirm the pressure with you before inflation.

situations.title: 적용 시각 기록
situations.tagline: Note the time — tourniquet's going up now.
situations.brief: 지혈대 적용 시작 시각을 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: Tourniquet up at this time — I'm recording it.
Let's mark the inflation time on the board.
I'll track ischemia time from now.

situations.title: 하부 패딩 적용
situations.tagline: Let's make sure there's good padding under the cuff.
situations.brief: 지혈대 하부에 패딩을 적용해 피부를 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: We pad the limb before applying the cuff.
Smooth padding prevents skin injury.
Let me check there are no wrinkles underneath.

situations.title: 부착부 상태 확인
situations.tagline: How does the skin look where the cuff will sit?
situations.brief: 지혈대 부착부의 사지 피부 상태를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me inspect the skin before we apply the cuff.
The limb looks intact with no breakdown.
I'm noting the baseline skin condition.

situations.title: 커프 크기 선택
situations.tagline: Which cuff size fits this patient's thigh best?
situations.brief: 사지 둘레에 맞는 지혈대 커프 크기를 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me choose the right cuff size for this limb.
The cuff should overlap properly without being too tight.
This size fits the circumference well.

situations.title: 시간 알람 확인
situations.tagline: Is the tourniquet timer set to alert us?
situations.brief: 지혈대 시간 알람이 설정되었는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The timer alarm is set to warn us at the limit.
Let me confirm the alert is active.
We'll get an audible reminder before max time.

situations.title: 최대 허용 시간 관리
situations.tagline: We're approaching the safe tourniquet limit — heads up.
situations.brief: 지혈대 안전 시간을 감시하며 최대 허용 시간을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're at the safe time limit — I'm alerting the team.
Ischemia time is getting close to the maximum.
Do we need to deflate soon?

situations.title: 재관류 전 팀 고지
situations.tagline: Let the team know before I deflate the tourniquet.
situations.brief: 재관류 전 지혈대 deflation을 팀에 고지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm about to release the tourniquet — everyone ready?
Anesthesia, be prepared for reperfusion changes.
Deflating now — watch the blood pressure.

situations.title: 허혈 시간 소통
situations.tagline: What's our total ischemia time now?
situations.brief: 허혈 시간을 팀과 공유하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Total ischemia time is now recorded and shared.
I'll call out the time every fifteen minutes.
Everyone should know how long the cuff's been up.

situations.title: 이중 커프 부위마취
situations.tagline: We're using a double cuff for the Bier block — which one first?
situations.brief: 부위마취 시 이중 커프(double cuff)를 순서에 맞게 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: We inflate the proximal cuff first for the block.
Once it's established, we switch to the distal cuff.
Let me confirm the sequence with anesthesia.

situations.title: 말초혈관질환 주의
situations.tagline: This patient has PVD — should we even use a tourniquet?
situations.brief: 말초혈관질환(PVD) 환자에서 지혈대 사용 위험을 주의하세요.
keyPhrases: With PVD, the tourniquet carries added risk.
Let's discuss whether it's safe for this limb.
I'll flag the vascular history to the surgeon.

situations.title: 소아 압력 조정
situations.tagline: For a child this size, the cuff pressure needs adjusting down.
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 지혈대 압력을 체구에 맞게 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Pediatric limbs need a lower occlusion pressure.
Let me recalculate based on the child's size.
We use the smallest appropriate cuff.

situations.title: 압흔 손상 예방
situations.tagline: Let's double-check the cuff isn't pinching the skin.
situations.brief: 지혈대에 의한 압박 손상을 예방하도록 부착 상태를 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Make sure the skin isn't pinched under the cuff.
No fluid should pool beneath the tourniquet.
Smooth padding prevents pressure injury.

situations.title: 재적용 시간 관리
situations.tagline: If we reinflate, how long can we safely go this time?
situations.brief: 지혈대 재적용 시 안전 시간을 다시 판단해 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: After reperfusion, the safe reinflation time resets shorter.
Let me track the new interval carefully.
We allow a rest period before reinflating.

situations.title: 하지 정맥울혈 감시
situations.tagline: The leg looks congested below the cuff — is that expected?
situations.brief: 하지 정맥울혈 징후를 감시하고 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The limb looks congested — I'm watching for venous pooling.
Let me check if exsanguination was adequate.
I'll report the color changes to the surgeon.

situations.title: 허용 시간 초과 임박
situations.tagline: We're one minute from exceeding the max tourniquet time — we have to act.
situations.brief: 지혈대 허용 시간 초과가 임박하면 강하게 경고하고 조치를 촉구하세요.
keyPhrases: We're at the maximum safe time — we need to deflate now.
I'm escalating this, the limb is at risk.
Surgeon, we cannot exceed this time.
goals: 허용 시간 초과 임박을 강하게 경고한다

situations.title: 재관류 저혈압 발생
situations.tagline: Pressure's dropping fast right after deflation — this is reperfusion hypotension.
situations.brief: 재관류 후 저혈압이 발생하면 즉시 인지하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: BP is dropping after release — this is reperfusion hypotension.
Anesthesia, do you need me to grab fluids or pressors?
I'm watching the monitor closely with you.

situations.title: 지혈대 신경마비 손상
situations.tagline: The limb was compressed too long — I'm worried about nerve palsy.
situations.brief: 지혈대에 의한 신경마비가 의심되면 대응하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Prolonged pressure may have caused nerve injury.
Let's document the deficit and inform the surgeon.
We need a neuro assessment postoperatively.

situations.title: 압력 오류 지속 출혈
situations.tagline: The field's still bleeding — the cuff pressure must be failing.
situations.brief: 압력 오류로 지속 출혈이 발생하면 원인을 파악하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: There's continued bleeding — let me check the cuff pressure.
The tourniquet may not be occluding fully.
I'm troubleshooting the device now.

situations.title: 재관류 대사 급변
situations.tagline: After deflation the potassium and CO2 are spiking — this is a metabolic crisis.
situations.brief: 재관류 후 대사성 급변이 발생하면 위기로 인지하고 팀과 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We're seeing a metabolic surge after reperfusion.
Anesthesia, do you need labs or treatment drawn up?
I'm ready to assist with whatever you need.

situations.title: 장시간 허혈 근손상
situations.tagline: That was a long ischemia time — we need to assess for muscle damage.
situations.brief: 장시간 허혈 후 근손상 가능성을 평가하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: With that ischemia time, muscle injury is a concern.
Let's watch for compartment signs postoperatively.
I'll document the total tourniquet time carefully.
